{{Top}}
{{Quote|Language is an organism. The entity of language is born, germinates, hybrids itself, and through the earnestness of social and political forces, languages can even die.|[[Arner Figgis]], [[Chief Linguist]] at the [[University of Be'nal]] on [[Issor]]|<ref name="Old Corellian: A Guide for the Curious Scholar">{{JournalCite|7|Old Corellian: A Guide for the Curious Scholar}}</ref>}}
There were a number of '''languages''' throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], of which the most common was [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Galactic Basic]]. It was not uncommon for beings to speak at least two languages in addition to their native tongue, particularly among those involved in spacefaring occupations and those who had attended military or educational academies.

==Common languages==
{{Quote|The ability to speak does not make you intelligent.|[[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]]|<ref name="Episode 1">{{Film|I}}</ref>}}
===Galactic Basic Standard===
[[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Galactic Basic Standard]], also known as Galactic Standard, was a constructed language, inspired largely by the languages of the various founding [[Species/Legends|species]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]: the [[Human/Legends|Humans]], the [[Duros/Legends|Duros]], and the [[Bothan/Legends|Bothans]]. It was the lingua franca of the galaxy, and almost all Humans spoke it instead of their historical language.

Galactic Basic used the [[Aurebesh/Legends|Aurebesh]] script.

Some aliens had difficulty speaking Basic, often due to the structure of their vocal cords or analogous organ.

===Binary===
[[Binary/Legends|Binary]], or Droidspeak, was a language of beeps, trills, and whistles spoken primarily by [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droids]] such as [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]]. It was also spoken by other models of [[Droid/Legends|droid]]. Organic beings who spent a lot of time with droids could often pick up a basic understanding as well.

===Bocce===
[[Bocce/Legends|Bocce]] was an artificial language used by [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]]. It was composed of elements from several languages.

===Bothese===
[[Bothese]] was the language of the [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] species, natives of the planet [[Bothawui/Legends|Bothawui]], and barthalemeu.

===Catharese===
[[Catharese]] was the language spoken by the [[Cathar/Legends|Cathar]] species, natives of the planet [[Cathar (location)/Legends|Cathar]].

===Cheunh===
[[Cheunh/Legends|Cheunh]] was the language of the [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] species, a dominant force in the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]].

===Dosh===
[[Dosh/Legends|Dosh]] was the language of the [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] species, natives of the planet [[Trandosha/Legends|Trandosha]].

===Dug language===
[[Dug (language)/Legends|Dug]] was the language of the [[Dug/Legends|Dug]] species, natives to the planet [[Malastare/Legends|Malastare]].

===Durese===
The [[Durese/Legends|Duros language]] remained a popular language among space travelers due to the abundance of Duro spacefarers, despite the predominance of Basic.

===Ewokese===
[[Ewokese/Legends|Ewokese]] was the language of the [[Ewok/Legends|Ewok]] species, natives of the [[Endor/Legends|Forest Moon]] of the [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giant]] [[Endor (planet)/Legends|Endor]].

===Gamorrese===
[[Gamorrese]] was the language of the [[Gamorrean/Legends|Gamorrean]] species, natives of the planet [[Gamorr/Legends|Gamorr]].

===Geonosian language===
Geonosian was the language of the [[Geonosian/Legends|Geonosian]] species native to [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]]. It consisted of click consonants, possible through the dual-mandibles of Geonosians&mdash;one moving vertically, and a second, internal set moving horizontally.

===Hapan language===
The [[Hapan (language)|Hapan language]] was spoken by residents of the [[Hapes Cluster/Legends|Hapes Cluster]].

===High Galactic===
[[High Galactic (language)|High Galactic]] was a prestige language, most commonly used among [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] courtiers.

===Huttese===
[[Huttese/Legends|Huttese]], the language of the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]], was popular among criminals, especially in the (considerable) sections of the galaxy where the Hutt criminal network was powerful.

===Jawaese===
[[Jawaese/Legends|Jawaese]] was the language of the [[Jawa/Legends|Jawa]] species, natives of the planet [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].

===Kaleesh language===
[[Kaleesh (language)|Kaleesh]] was the language of the [[Kaleesh/Legends|Kaleesh]] species, natives of the planet [[Kalee/Legends|Kalee]].

===Kaminoan language===
[[Kaminoan (language)/Legends|Kaminoan]] was the language of the [[Kaminoan/Legends|Kaminoan]] species, natives of the planet [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]].

===Mando'a===
[[Mando'a/Legends|Mando'a]] was the traditional language spoken by [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]].

===Olys Corellisi===
[[Olys Corellisi/Legends|Olys Corellisi]] ("Old Corellian") was the language spoken by the original settlers of [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]]. It became extinct around [[4000 BBY/Legends|4000 BBY]].

===Pak Pak===
[[Pak Pak/Legends|Pak Pak]] was the language of the [[Neimoidian/Legends|Neimoidian]] sub-species, native of the planet [[Neimoidia/Legends|Neimoidia]].

===Rodese===
The native tongue of the [[Rodian/Legends|Rodians]], [[Rodese/Legends|Rodese]], was popular due to the large number of spacefaring Rodians.

===Shyriiwook===
[[Shyriiwook/Legends|Shyriiwook]] was the main language of the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiees]]. It was considered the most emotive of Wookiee tongues, as opposed to the technical [[Thykarann/Legends|Thykarann]] or tribal [[Xaczik/Legends|Xaczik]] dialects. It could be understood by those who spoke Basic, but it was nearly impossible for non-Wookiees to pronounce.

===Snivvian language===
[[Snivvian (language)|Snivvian]] was the language of the [[Snivvian/Legends|Snivvian]] species, natives of the planet [[Cadomai Prime/Legends|Cadomai Prime]].

===Sullustese===
[[Sullustese/Legends|Sullustese]] was the language of the [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] species, natives of the planet [[Sullust/Legends|Sullust]].

===Sith language===
[[Sith (language)|Sith]] was the native language of the people of [[Ziost/Legends|Ziost]] and [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]]. Later it, became the language of the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]]. The language had at least two dialects, Sith and High Sith.

===Tarc language===
The Tarc language was spoken by the [[Tarc]] [[Species/Legends|species]], who were unable to speak [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Galactic Basic Standard]].

===Togruti===
[[Togruti/Legends|Togruti]] was one of the main languages of the [[Togruta/Legends|Togruta]] species, natives of the planet [[Shili/Legends|Shili]]. The language was often spoken partnered with [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Galactic Basic Standard]].

===Twi'leki===
[[Twi'leki/Legends|Twi'leki]], commonly known as Ryl, was the language of the [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] species, natives of the planet [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]].

===Tusken===
[[Tusken/Legends|Tusken]] was the language of the [[Tusken Raider/Legends|Tusken Raider]] species, natives of the planet [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].

===Yuuzhan Vong===
The [[Yuuzhan Vong (language)|language]] of the [[Extragalactic/Legends|extra-galactic]] [[Yuuzhan Vong]] invaders and their [[Chazrach]] [[Slavery/Legends|slaves]] was guttural and grammatically different from Basic, but otherwise straightforward.

==Droids and computers==
[[Droid/Legends|Droids]] and computers used either the natural languages that their masters used, usually [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Basic]], or special machine languages. [[Protocol droid/Legends|Protocol droids]] such as [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] were "fluent in over six million forms of communication" and were often employed as translators, with the ability to also download new language packs for languages such as [[Tusken language pack|Tusken]].<ref name="CWAG">[[Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures (video game)|''Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures'']]</ref> [[Astromech droid/Legends|Astromech droids]] such as [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] were able to understand commands in Basic and perhaps other languages, but could only communicate through an information-dense language of beeps and whistles; devices existed that could translate this language into Basic, such as the display in an [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing]] cockpit that allowed the ship's astromech and pilot to commmunicate. Simpler droids communicated only through sounds indicating affirmative/negative, or other simple replies.

==Behind the scenes==
In the [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars|''The Clone Wars'']] episode ''[[Liberty on Ryloth]]'', an [[Aurebesh/Legends|Aurebesh]] [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] display includes the text "UND UBERHAUPT," [[Wikipedia:German language|German]] for "and anyway." In ''[[The Academy]]'', when [[Soniee/Legends|Soniee]] and her fellow [[Royal Academy of Government/Legends|students]] break into the [[Government warehouse/Legends|Government warehouse]], her [[Datapad/Legends|datapad]] says "ENTRARE," [[Wikipedia:Italian language|Italian]] for "enter."<ref name="SWArchive-''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: The Academy">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode306.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: The Academy}}</ref>

[[Mando'a/Legends|Mando'a]] has become a usable [[Wikipedia:constructed language|constructed language]], developed by author [[Karen Traviss]].
